name: zeta-connect
description: Zeta Connect: multi-tenant WhatsApp automation SaaS (MERN monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
